# Templates

- `quote-template.md`, `invoice-template.md`: copy, fill in, keep the copies outside this repo.
- `lead-tracker-TEMPLATE.csv`, `sales-expenses-TEMPLATE.csv`: header rows only.

**Working copies live OUTSIDE the repo** (for example a private folder such as `~/clear-signs-private/`, or a spreadsheet in a cloud drive). This repo holds no customer names, phone numbers, invoices or bank details. Copy the template, rename it (drop `-TEMPLATE`) and work on the copy.
